newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Pioneer Fin'l Services cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Pioneer Fin'l Services cut.

text.p: -- Advest Inc said analyst Gloria Vogel cut Pioneer Financial Services to a hold from a buy.
-- The brokerage said Vogel had made no changes to her estimates.
-- The downgrade follows Conseco Inc's deal to acquire Pioneer, in a deal that valued Pioneer at between $25 and $28 per share.
-- Pioneer Financial closed at $24-3/8, unchanged on Tuesday, after rising 5-1/2 points on Monday, the day the deal with Conseco was announced.
